description.en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

description.zh:
网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。

> 如果当前网络实例为跨账号网络实例，本参数必填。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs.

> This parameter is required if the network instance belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account.
The ID of the network instance.

description.zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the network instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

- **VPC**：表示专有网络实例。
- **VBR**：表示边界路由器实例。
description.en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: a virtual private cloud (VPC).

- **VBR**: a virtual border router (VBR).

description.zh:
路由条目的目标网段。

目标网段为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24。
description.en:
The destination CIDR block of the route.

The destination CIDR block must be in CIDR format. Example: 192.168.10.0/24.
The ID of the route table of the network instance.

title.zh: 删除网络实例下的路由条目

descriptions.zh:
- DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口默认不开放，如需使用，请<props="china">[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/cbn/today)</props><props="intl">[提交工单](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>申请。
- DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口不支持删除企业版转发路由器下网络实例的路由条目。
descriptions.en:
- The DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation is not available by default. To use this operation, <props="china">[submit a ticket](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/cbn/today)</props><props="intl">[submit a ticket](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>.

- You cannot use the DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation to delete routes from a network instance that is attached to an Enterprise Edition transit router.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn delete-cen-child-instance-route-entry-to-cen --cen-id cen-7febra5nqj7jjh0000 --child-instance-id vpc-k1alm2jbuwibhxtx20000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id ap-southeast-5 --child-instance-ali-uid 1787100000000000 --route-table-id vtb-k1aa8ulqs39f86op80000 --destination-cidr-block 192.168.22.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
